mitre_attack_techniques.signature_description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic.
Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents on the system or in transit.
Adversaries may perform software packing or virtual machine software protection to conceal their code.

signature_matches.name: reference analysis tools strings
signature_matches.description: anti-analysis
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: reference analysis tools strings
    namespace: anti-analysis
    authors:
      - michael.hunhoff@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    mbc:
      - Discovery::Analysis Tool Discovery::Process detection [B0013.001]
    references:
      - https://github.com/LordNoteworthy/al-khaser/blob/master/al-khaser/AntiAnalysis/process.cpp
    examples:
      - al-khaser_x86.exe_
  features:
    - or:
      - string: /ollydbg(\.exe)?/i
      - string: /ProcessHacker(\.exe)?/i
      - string: /tcpview(\.exe)?/i
      - string: /autoruns(\.exe)?/i

      - string: /ImmunityDebugger(\.exe)?/i
      - string: /Wireshark(\.exe)?/i

signature_matches.name: contains PDB path
signature_matches.description: executable/pe/pdb
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: contains PDB path
    namespace: executable/pe/pdb
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    examples:
      - 464EF2CA59782CE697BC329713698CCC  # level32.exe
  features:
    - string: /:\\.*\.pdb/

signature_matches.name: packer_unknown_pe_section_name
signature_matches.description: The binary contains an unknown PE section name indicative of packing
Sample execution stops while process was sleeping (likely an evasion)
PE file has an executable .text section and no other executable section
Reads software policies
PE file contains a mix of data directories often seen in goodware
Classification label
Sample tries to load a library which is not present or installed on the analysis machine, adding the library might reveal more behavior
Spawns processes
PE file has a high image base, often used for DLLs
Contains modern PE file flags such as dynamic base (ASLR) or NX
Tries to load missing DLLs
Creates mutexes
Program does not show much activity (idle)
PE / OLE file has a valid certificate
PE file contains a valid data directory to section mapping
Binary contains paths to debug symbols
PE file contains a debug data directory
URLs found in memory or binary data
Creates mutexes
